title: Twist E22: Projected additive energy and relation-yield diagnostics
status_note: Partial local evidence, 2026-10-23; full experiment blocked and unfunded. All pair/triple histograms and energies recomputed, with 960 random controls. Independent rank/yield controls and complete collector cost remain partial. Complete raw publication awaits artifact-store credentials.
blocked_on: note:All pair/triple histograms and energies recomputed, with 960 random controls. Independent rank/yield controls and complete collector cost remain partial.
question: Do coupled trace images have an additive structure that predicts more useful decompositions after cardinality and fiber multiplicity are controlled?
decision_value: A robust structural difference selects a specifically frozen family for further work. An energy increase without independent-row or cost improvement is not a collection win. A known-log diagnostic is never presented as an executable DLP shortcut.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB, at most 2^20 pair/group operations per base and 60 seconds per histogram cell; an incomplete histogram stays incomplete. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Partial local twist.followup-run/v1 evidence exists; original full acceptance criteria remain unmet. See execution-v2 and the follow-up report.
